scripts.db:psql: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec postgres psql -U postgres -d incident_management
scripts.db:tables: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec postgres psql -U postgres -d incident_management -c "\dt"
scripts.db:migrations: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec postgres psql -U postgres -d incident_management -c "select migration_name, finished_at from _prisma_migrations order by finished_at;"
scripts.db:counts: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec postgres psql -U postgres -d incident_management -c "select 'users' as table_name, count(*) from users union all select 'teams', count(*) from teams union all select 'services', count(*) from services union all select 'incidents', count(*) from incidents union all select 'notification_logs', count(*) from notification_logs;"
